item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Toraji will move across the northern part of the South China Sea towards the vicinity of the western coast of Guangdong to the Pearl River Estuary in the next couple of days. Under the combined effect of Toraji and the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen gradually with squally showers over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. Toraji is expected to weaken when edging closer to the coastal areas, but the rate of weakening remains uncertain. A strong northeast monsoon will affect southern China early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will move towards the coast of central Vietnam and dissipate today and tomorrow. The tropical cyclone near Yap will develop gradually and move in the general direction of the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days. There are uncertainties in its subsequent movement.
